note: Revision 2, with the two changes you asked for: the saddle now fits a 140 mm wide arm (144 mm inside, the same 4 mm of play as before), and each pocket is 40% of its remote's length deep instead of half (72, 60 and 56 mm), so more of each remote sticks out to grab. Nothing else changed. The caddy is now 175 x 140 x 74 mm and a little lighter, so the price came down.
